title: Best 18V Battery (2026)
summary: The 6.0 Ah Ryobi 18V ONE+ replacement battery is the top pick for most buyers.
method: Selected products that appear in more than one source (Ryobi 18V ONE+ batteries). Sources used: CEENR Engineering (source 4) and RD Batteries Blog (source 3).
assumptions: Prices are not included because no source provided a price.

products.name: Ryobi 18V ONE+ 6.0 Ah Replacement Battery
why: The 6.0 Ah pack offers more capacity than Ryobi’s 4 Ah packs for a fraction of the price.
It has a 3‑year warranty and is documented to have premium high‑drain cells matched to each capacity.
products.desc: The Ryobi 18V ONE+ 6.0 Ah Replacement Battery is a lithium‑ion pack that fits any ONE+ tool. It has a 6.0 Ah capacity and a 3‑year warranty. It does not include a charger.
products.benefit: Picture a homeowner who needs more runtime for a long day of yard work. The 6.0 Ah pack gives more capacity than Ryobi’s 4 Ah packs for a fraction of the price, and it comes with a 3‑year warranty. It beats the 5 Ah pack because it has the highest capacity in this guide. The catch: it is larger and heavier than the 5 Ah pack.
products.skip_if: If you only need a short task or have a tight budget

products.desc: The Ryobi 18V ONE+ 5.0 Ah Replacement Battery is a lithium‑ion pack that fits any ONE+ tool. It has a 5.0 Ah capacity and a 3‑year warranty. It does not include a charger.
products.benefit: Picture a budget‑conscious homeowner who still wants decent runtime. The 5.0 Ah pack offers more capacity than the 4 Ah pack at a lower price than the 6.0 Ah pack, and it is lighter. It wins against the 6.0 Ah pack for weight and cost.
